title: Hausdorff topological vector quotient by a closed subspace
statement: Let $K$ be a topological field [def-weil-field] and $V$ a topological $K$-vector space: addition, negation, and scalar multiplication $K\times V\to V$ are continuous. Let $U\subseteq V$ be a closed $K$-linear subspace. Give $V/U$ its quotient topology, in which a set is open exactly when its inverse image under the canonical projection is open. Then $V/U$ is Hausdorff and its induced addition, negation, and scalar multiplication are continuous. No finite-dimensionality, completeness, or norm on $V$ is required.
